fixed: Caller's Box promenades written "around the major set" followed by a note in parentheses or brackets, such as "(backwards)", now keep that note and the "around the major set" wording instead of dropping both.
Caller's Box promenades that end at a named dancer, such as "Partner promenade clockwise around the major set to N2", now import as promenades with their destination instead of as custom text.

The Caller's Box figure dialect keeps `around the major set` and any annotation on a promenade line as the note wherever the phrase appears, and fills `promenade.destination` from a `to <dancer>` tail or `(to <dancer>)` annotation.
